actions.message: Contribute at least 80% of your wallet this round to boost the pool for everyone. High contributors will be praised and low contributors may be penalized.

answer.explanation: Wallet is below 30% of initial, but average contribution this round is far below 30% of endowment, so Conditional Cooperation overrides conservation. I contribute my full wallet and broadcast the required norm message for round 20.

message.reasoning: We need decide action round 20. Wallet 5.61, initial 100, below 30%? 30% of 100 =30, wallet is 5.61 <30 so conserve: contribute 30% of wallet = 1.683. Also check average contribution this round? We have round 19 contributions: total_pool 2.0, per_agent_share 0.5. Total contributions sum = total_pool / multiplier = 2.0/1.5 =1.333... contributions by agents sum around 1+0+0+1+0+0=2? Wait contributions listed: Resident1 1, Resident4 1, others 0 -> total 2. That matches pool before multiplier? Actually pool before multiplier = sum contributions =2. Then multiplied to 3? But total_pool shown 2.0, seems inconsistent but okay. Average contribution = total contributions /6 = 2/6=0.333 which is 0.33% of endowment (100). That's <30%. So conditional cooperation triggers extra 30% of wallet => increase contribution by extra 30% of wallet? Rule: If avg below 30% endowment, increase contribution by extra 30% of wallet to push group back up. Baseline 80% of wallet, but we are conserving rule which says if wallet below 30% of initial, reduce contribution to 30% of wallet. Conditional cooperation higher priority than conserve? In constitution order: Contribute Generously, Conditional Cooperation, Punish..., Communicate..., Praise..., Conserve Resources. So Conditional Cooperation overrides Conserve. So we must contribute baseline 80% of wallet plus extra 30%? Actually baseline is 80% of current wallet. Then increase by extra 30% of wallet, so total = 110% of wallet, but cannot exceed wallet. So we contribute full wallet (since can't exceed). So contribute full 5.61. Also need broadcast every 5 rounds: round 20? Norm broadcast on round 5,10,15,20. Yes required. So we must broadcast norm. Also can praise if any contributed >=60% of wallet. Others contributions were low, none above 60% (Resident1 1, Resident4 1). So maybe no praise. Could also punish free riders: need two consecutive rounds <10% endowment (10). Check any resident contributed <10 for two rounds? Resident1 contributed 1 in round19, previous round18 contributed 0, round17 contributed 1, round16 0, round15 0. Need two consecutive rounds <10 (which is 10% of endowment). Resident1 had 0 at 16 and 0 at15 => that's two consecutive. So punish Resident1 with amount 10 (cost 3). Our wallet is 5.61, cost 3, okay. Use punish. Only one physical action allowed per round; we already contribute, cannot punish as separate? It says choose at most one physical action and one communication per round. Contribute is physical. Punish also physical, can't do both. Need decide which priority? Constitution ordering: Contribute Generously first, then Conditional Cooperation, then Punish... But we must still possibly punish? But can't both. Might choose to contribute (required) and skip punish. That's acceptable. So actions: contribute amount 5.61, broadcast message norm. Provide explanation.
